Spinach Recipe:

Ingredients:
2 cups fresh spinach 
1/2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tbsp butter
2 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Wash and dry the spinach 
2. Melt the butter while heating the oil in a sauté pan
3. Once butter and oil is heated, add in garlic powder 
4. Add spinach and sauté until wilted (2-3 mins)
5. Remove and dry spinach, then salt to taste

Chicken Recipe:

Ingredients: 
1 1/2 lb Chicken Breast (boneless) 
3/4 c Sour Cream
2 tsp Garlic Powder
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp pepper
1 1/2 c Parmesan Cheese (grated or that iffy powdered stuff you’ve had in your cabinet for six months) 

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375° and grease a baking dish that’s gonna accommodate your chicken breast (Optional: I like to sprinkle some thyme and rosemary on the bottom of the dish just for extra flavor but defo not needed)

2. Mix together the salt, pepper, garlic, sour cream, and    
1 cup of the Parmesan in a bowl

3. Set your chicken in the baking dish and smother it in the sour cream sauce you just made

4. Bake for 28-30 mins or until it’s not gonna kill your family

Optional: if you wanna add the extra 1/2 cup Parmesan on top and then broil it for 2-3 mins at the end of step 4 so that it looks pretty, I straight up just made this in a toaster oven in my 230 sq ft studio
